key_concepts: Matter is anything that has weight and occupies space.
Matter exists in three forms: solid, liquid, and gas.
Solids can be touched, seen, smelled, and felt.
Solids have definite shape, size, and volume.
The shape of a solid does not change.
Solids are made of small particles that are close together.
Solids can be grouped by shape, texture, and color.
Common solid shapes include circle, rectangle, square, triangle, and oval.
Solid textures include rough, soft, smooth, and hard.
Solids can have different colors such as red, yellow, blue, green, and orange.
